sourceNotes.rawContent: Brighten your jewelry collection with this premium pastel chevron enamel kada. Expertly crafted with a high-quality gold finish, its anti-tarnish and water-resistant properties ensure long-lasting brilliance. This chic geometric statement piece offers a luxurious, modern aesthetic that maintains its stunning luster through everyday wear.
